content: Kiro spec-driven flow: requirements -> design -> tasks with explicit human approval at each phase gate (natural pause points, prevents runaway automation); steering files in .kiro/steering/ give project-wide context read before every action; spec files are living documentation teams review/comment via standard dev workflows. Time-to-spec-approval typically <20 min. Pain points remain: specs verbose, review inside IDE, English-only. Table stakes signal: phase-gated human approval + persistent steering/context files are now expected in spec workflows.
